title: CONFORM: Contrast is All You Need For High-Fidelity Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
role: Training-free latent optimisation that repels the two subjects' cross-attention maps by cosine similarity; a no-box candidate fix whose similarity is the overlap predictor this loop plans to compute
enters_evidence: argument from visualised maps on single prompts: overlapping bear and elephant maps give only elephants (Fig. 2a), attribute maps scatter over steps (Fig. 3); no measurement across prompts
changes: InfoNCE loss on cosine similarity of 16x16 cross-attention maps (attract a subject to its attributes and its own step t+1 map, repel other subjects), one gradient step on z_t with alpha 20, tau 0.5, iterations 0 to 25 of 50, repeated at 0, 10, 20
training: nothing trained; needs the token indices of each subject and its attribute words (grouping source not stated); no boxes, masks, LLM or reference image
model: SD1.5 and Imagen (T5-XL); resolution and sampler not printed; claimed model-agnostic; no SDXL
similar_subjects: Animal-Animal (66 prompts x 64 seeds), SD1.5: TIFA 0-1 higher better 0.95 vs D&B 0.93, A&E 0.92, SD 0.68; text-text CLIP 0.82 vs D&B 0.81, SD 0.76; user votes 72% vs A&E 14.75%; Imagen TIFA 0.84 vs 0.84 (no gain); all metrics score presence, none scores part borrowing
which_pairs: not measured per pair; argues overlapping subject maps let one subject take over, and cites DAAM for co-hyponyms (same-category words) entangling cross-attention features
when: not measured as a number; attribute attention scatters over backward steps (Fig. 3); optimising after iteration 25 of 50 gave artifacts; a poor initial attention map limits recovery (Fig. 8a)
cost: about 20 s per prompt (reads as per image) on an NVIDIA L4, SD1.5, 50 iterations; per optimised step one extra UNet backward plus forward, repeats at iterations 0, 10, 20; no plain-SD time printed
headline: TIFA (0-1 VQA accuracy, higher better) on Animal-Animal with SD1.5: 0.95 against Divide & Bind 0.93, Attend-and-Excite 0.92 and SD 0.68
suggests: (inferred) compute the cross-attention overlap predictor as CONFORM's cosine between the two subject maps over steps 0-25; CONFORM is a no-box alternative fix on CO3's joint-prompt pass at one extra backward per step, but nothing in the paper shows it reduces part borrowing between two bodies that are both present
